links.note: Mustard seeds from wheat grains is a solid-solid mixture whose components differ in size, which is the stated condition for sieving in 32752. Not winnowing (32751): both components are heavy grains.

Cream/butter from milk or curd is what 32759 states churning does, with the lighter butter floating. It is printed as an exercise, but the content it tests is the churning section, not the exercise set's condition-testing.

Pore size as the governing factor: 32757 is the concept that grades cloth pores against filter-paper pores and says the choice of filter depends on the size of the particles to be removed. 32756 only names filtration.
Nasal hair as a filter medium trapping dust while air passes - the filter-media idea of 32757 (cotton, charcoal, sand), transferred outside the laboratory.
A mask is a fabric filter whose fibre weave holds droplets back - again 32757's filter-material and pore-size principle rather than 32756's naming of filtration.
Definition of handpicking on differences in size, colour and shape - 32749's own wording.
Nani's courtyard: small stones and husk picked from grains by hand. 32750 is the next scene (threshing).
The condition for handpicking - small quantities, easily picked by hand - stated in 32749.
Threshing defined as beating stalks to free the grains - 32750.
Activity 9.1's roasted peanuts: the lighter skins blow away. 32751 is winnowing, where that activity sits.
Winnowing's principle - lighter component carried off by wind - 32751.
Sieving for a solid-solid mixture with different particle sizes - the rule 32752 states after making the reader examine the holes.
Filtration is named in 32756, where the strainer catches all the tea leaves and decantation is judged incomplete. 32757 is the following step - media and pore size.
Filter paper's very fine pores against cloth pores - the comparison 32757 draws.
A cross-method comparison (solid-from-liquid against solid-from-solid-by-size). 32761 is the one place the definitions stand side by side; 32752 and 32757 each hold only one half.
The fishing net draining water through its mesh is 32758's own scene, where Valli recognises filtration outside a kitchen.
Churning curd with a mathni to take out butter - 32759.
Definition of magnetic separation - 32760, the sawdust-and-nails section.
The soop, a bamboo tray, is the winnowing tool described in 32751.
Threshing against winnowing side by side: 32761's list states both in sequence. 32750 and 32751 each define one only.
Sand and sugar needs two steps in a fixed order - filtration/decantation, then evaporation. That ordering skill is 32763, not any single method concept.
Flour through the holes, bran retained - the bran-from-flour case that 32752 is built on.
Mami's meethi puri and removing bran before kneading is 32752's opening scene.
Why stones are removed at all - Nani's reason that the grains be fit for cooking, which 32749 calls the chapter's first answer to why anything is separated.
The Ayurveda shade-drying note, which evaporates excess water and leaves the medicine behind, is in 32754. 32753 is the salt-pan sun; this item is the note attached to Activity 9.3.
Pebbles and stones from sand at a construction site is 32752's second setting; the option's handpicking branch leans on 32749's quantity condition, but the scenario is the sieve's.
Settling then pouring off - sedimentation and decantation, which 32756 defines together as two halves of one operation.
Residue against filtrate is named only in 32757, at Activity 9.4.
